Marketing.heroTitle: One command center for detection, compliance, response, and training.
Marketing.heroBody: Sentinel Oversight replaces the spreadsheet-and-Slack version of your security program with a single, auditable system of record — built for teams who answer to a board, a regulator, or both.
Marketing.pillarThreatBody: Real-time visibility into login attempts, traffic anomalies, and suspicious events across every system you run.
Marketing.pillarComplianceBody: Live status against SOC 2 Type II, GDPR, and HIPAA with an audit checklist that stays current, not a quarterly spreadsheet.
Marketing.pillarResponseBody: Playbooks that trigger on detection, cut mean-time-to-respond, and log every mitigation step for the post-incident review.
Marketing.pillarTrainingBody: A training catalog your team actually finishes, with completion tracking tied to your real risk posture.
